requirements.location: Complete outline, sections1–9 and material/dependency paragraphs.
requirements.basis: Read the complete current case, author outline and requirements assignment. Sections1–2 separate chemistry, electrolyte, form and pack integration while covering LFP/LMFP, ternary, sodium and solid-state/transition routes. Sections2–4 plan the requested cell/pack/vehicle conditions, charging/temperature/life/safety comparison rather than a composite best-case product. Sections5–6 retain cost types, units, dated assumptions, yield/utilization/material and lifetime sensitivities. Section7 plans distinct commercialization stages and contradictory or limiting evidence. Section8 explicitly maps choices to all four requested vehicle/use cases and changing conditions. Section9 retains the matrices, calculations and dated commercialization chain needed for a complete report. Public gaps are located and planned for source recovery or a narrowed claim, not invented internal costs. Chinese full-report output and2026-11-09 cutoff are explicit. No required topic or requested exhibit is absent at the outline stage; factual rows and computed results still require their later substantive examination.
